score_method: 100-point Future Monster Fingerprint score. The standardized 0–10 market/relative-strength component is now applied to ranked, Rising, and Watchlist names where comparable 3M, 6M, 52W, and drawdown data are complete. ELF remains explicitly incomplete because its indexed multi-horizon table predates the Aug. 5 earnings gap. An asterisk now means a required score component is still pending, rather than marking every score provisional. Scores are research rankings, not probabilities.

top15.name: Credo Technology Group
top15.why: Exceptional growth acceleration, strong profitability and margins, direct AI data-center connectivity demand, and a strong standardized market leg.
top15.risk: Customer concentration, valuation, or a sharp slowdown in AI networking demand could weaken the case.

top15.name: Astera Labs
top15.why: Rapid revenue acceleration, high-margin connectivity products, expanding AI-infrastructure demand, and strong multi-month price confirmation.
top15.risk: The case depends heavily on sustained AI infrastructure spending and successful expansion beyond a concentrated set of large customers.

top15.name: Reddit
top15.why: Strong revenue growth, expanding profitability and cash generation, growing user activity, and multiple monetization paths support the developing platform fingerprint.
top15.risk: Advertising cyclicality, user-growth deceleration, competition, or weaker monetization could compress the case quickly.

top15.name: Samsara
top15.why: Large and expanding recurring revenue, strong enterprise adoption, improving profitability, and constructive multi-month market confirmation support an early platform-leader fingerprint.
top15.risk: Premium valuation, competitive pressure, or slowing large-customer growth would weaken the fingerprint.

top15.name: Natera
top15.why: Rapid testing-volume expansion, rising revenue, improving margins, increasing oncology adoption, and one of the stronger standardized market legs.
top15.risk: Reimbursement, regulatory, litigation, or clinical-adoption setbacks could materially damage the case.

top15.name: Celestica
top15.why: Accelerating revenue, improving earnings power, and AI/data-center exposure remain strong, but recent price cooling reduced the market component.
top15.risk: Hardware-cycle volatility, customer concentration, and margin pressure could reduce the quality of the growth.

top15.name: Rubrik
top15.why: Strong subscription growth, improving cash generation, cybersecurity demand, and a constructive market leg create a scalable recurring-revenue case.
top15.risk: Competition, slower subscription expansion, or failure to sustain operating leverage could lower the rating.

top15.name: Nu Holdings
top15.why: Massive customer growth, strong profitability, high returns on equity, and continued Latin American expansion support a scalable financial-platform case.
top15.risk: Credit quality, regulation, foreign-exchange exposure, and slower customer monetization are the principal threats.

top15.name: Toast
top15.why: Restaurant-location growth, recurring revenue and improving profitability remain attractive despite a softer standardized market leg.
top15.risk: Restaurant industry weakness, slower location growth, or failure to expand operating leverage could flatten the trajectory.

top15.name: SoFi Technologies
top15.why: Strong member growth, improving profitability and expanding financial-services revenue remain positives, but multi-month price weakness now carries an explicit penalty.
top15.risk: Credit performance, funding conditions, and the durability of growth across multiple business lines remain important risks.

top15.name: SharkNinja
top15.why: Strong product innovation, category expansion, international opportunity, continued sales growth and a strong market component support the consumer-brand case.
top15.risk: Consumer demand can cool quickly and copycat competition, tariffs, channel inventory or failed product launches could hurt the case.

top15.name: Lumentum
top15.why: AI data-center optical demand is driving unusually strong growth and margin improvement, though recent technical damage offsets part of the longer-term strength.
top15.risk: Optical cycles can reverse quickly and customer concentration remains meaningful.

top15.name: Robinhood Markets
top15.why: Platform assets, funded customers and transaction activity continue expanding, but the standardized market pass now reflects weaker 6M and 52W confirmation.
top15.risk: Revenue remains exposed to market activity, regulation and crypto/trading cycles; enthusiasm can reverse quickly in weak markets.

top15.name: Nebius Group
top15.why: Exceptional 3M/6M/52W price confirmation strengthens an already powerful AI-infrastructure growth and capacity-expansion fingerprint.
top15.risk: The required capital is huge, profitability is immature, execution is demanding and financing/capex risk remains substantial.

top15.name: CAVA Group
top15.why: Strong unit expansion, positive traffic and healthy restaurant economics still support the case, but multi-month price weakness materially reduced the market component.
top15.risk: Restaurant expansion can destroy returns if new-unit economics weaken, traffic slows, or food and labor costs rise materially.

rising.name: Dave
rising.why: Rapid revenue and profit growth plus the strongest completed technical component on the Rising board create a compelling small-cap fintech fingerprint.
rising.risk: Regulatory and litigation exposure around lending products is substantial.
rising.next: Continued growth with reduced regulatory uncertainty and durable credit performance.

rising.name: Nextpower
rising.why: Large backlog, growing solar and power-system demand and new-product expansion remain attractive, but the standardized market leg fell well below the Top-15 cutoff.
rising.risk: Project timing, policy changes and solar-industry cyclicality can cause sharp swings.
rising.next: Rebuild multi-month relative strength while backlog converts cleanly into revenue and margins.

rising.name: e.l.f. Beauty
rising.why: Fiscal Q1 2027 sales accelerated 36% and management raised its full-year sales and profit outlook, materially improving the business case after the Aug. 5 report.
rising.risk: Acquisition complexity, leverage, tariff exposure and dependence on continued Rhode integration keep the risk overlay meaningful.
rising.next: A refreshed post-earnings 3M/6M/52W market table plus sustained core e.l.f. and Rhode momentum.

rising.name: Dutch Bros
rising.why: Strong unit growth, healthy consumer demand and a strong standardized market component support an early national-brand expansion fingerprint.
rising.risk: New-store economics and same-store traffic must remain healthy during rapid expansion.
rising.next: Another period of strong traffic, successful openings and sustained margins.

rising.name: Rocket Lab
rising.why: Fast revenue growth, backlog and launch activity remain compelling, but the current market component is weak ahead of the next earnings checkpoint.
rising.risk: It remains loss-making, requires heavy capital, and execution of Neutron is a major make-or-break dependency.
rising.next: Fresh earnings confirmation, better operating leverage and successful Neutron milestones.

rising.name: Affirm
rising.why: Large consumer and merchant networks plus expanding transaction volume support a broad payment-network opportunity.
rising.risk: Credit losses, funding costs and regulation remain central to the case.
rising.next: More consistent profitability and proof that growth remains strong through a less favorable credit environment.

rising.name: Coherent
rising.why: AI-related optical communications demand and improving earnings are strengthening the case, though recent price action cooled.
rising.risk: The business remains cyclical and requires continued margin improvement.
rising.next: Sustained growth, stronger free cash flow and evidence that AI demand is structurally durable.

rising.name: Tempus AI
rising.why: Rapid growth in diagnostics, data applications and molecular testing gives Tempus a differentiated healthcare-data and AI adoption story.
rising.risk: Profitability is still developing and the standardized market component is currently very weak.
rising.next: Stronger profitability and cash-flow evidence plus a durable recovery in relative strength.

rising.name: IREN Limited
rising.why: Explosive AI-cloud demand and infrastructure expansion create a very high-upside growth profile, but the recent technical trend is weak.
rising.risk: Capital intensity, financing needs, execution risk, customer concentration and infrastructure buildout remain substantial.
rising.next: Evidence that contracted AI demand converts into durable revenue and cash returns without excessive financing pressure.

rising.name: CoreWeave
rising.why: Massive AI infrastructure demand and backlog create extraordinary growth potential, but the market component and balance-sheet risk are both severe.
rising.risk: Very large losses, debt and capital requirements make the current financial risk unusually high.
rising.next: Clear evidence of improving unit economics, cash generation and manageable financing requirements.

watchlist.name: monday.com
watchlist.why: The business remains high quality with recurring software revenue and solid profitability.
watchlist.risk: Growth has moderated enough that the fingerprint is less explosive than the leading candidates.
watchlist.next: Reacceleration in enterprise demand or growth without sacrificing margins.

watchlist.name: Duolingo
watchlist.why: User engagement and brand strength remain exceptional, but the latest quarter showed revenue growth slowing to 18% and a softer next-quarter revenue outlook.
watchlist.risk: Monetization growth may lag user growth while expectations remain demanding.
watchlist.next: Renewed revenue acceleration and evidence that monetization can keep pace with user growth.

watchlist.name: TransMedics
watchlist.why: A differentiated organ-transplant platform and growing adoption create a compelling long-term story.
watchlist.risk: The freshest evidence needs deeper review before promotion.
watchlist.next: Verified acceleration in procedure volume, revenue and operating leverage.

watchlist.name: PROCEPT BioRobotics
watchlist.why: Robotic surgical adoption gives the company an attractive medical-technology opportunity.
watchlist.risk: Recent execution and inventory concerns weakened confidence.
watchlist.next: Restored execution, cleaner inventory trends and stronger guidance.

watchlist.name: Sezzle
watchlist.why: The company has shown rapid growth and profitability in buy-now-pay-later.
watchlist.risk: Recent forward expectations and price reaction suggest the growth case needs reconstruction.
watchlist.next: Improved guidance and evidence that growth remains durable without rising credit risk.

watchlist.name: Hims & Hers Health
watchlist.why: The company previously showed exceptional consumer-health growth and brand momentum, but the latest completed quarter materially weakened the fingerprint.
watchlist.risk: Growth, margin and profitability deterioration remain unresolved; Q2 2026 results are scheduled for August 10.
watchlist.next: A clean reacceleration in revenue, margins and profitability before promotion is justified.

watchlist.name: AST SpaceMobile
watchlist.why: Direct-to-device satellite broadband has an enormous addressable market if execution succeeds.
watchlist.risk: The business remains highly dependent on deployment, funding, regulation and technical execution.
watchlist.next: More operating satellites, commercial service evidence and clearer economics.
